title: Bind loaded Skill manifests to requested identity
goal: Prevent a faulty or adversarial SkillStore from returning a different manifest identity than requested and causing policy/executor confusion.
context: SkillRuntime.executeInternal and manifestForVerification trust SkillStore.load(id:) to return a manifest whose id equals the requested id. If a store violates that contract, the runtime may evaluate capabilities and resolve an executor for a different Skill than the caller requested.
forbidden_changes: Do not weaken policy checks, approval handling, executor verification, or cancellation.
Do not enable new capabilities or change workspace behavior.
Do not modify unrelated provider, UI, or project files.
acceptance_criteria: A loaded manifest must match the requested SkillID before policy evaluation or executor resolution.
Standalone verification must fail closed if a store returns a manifest with the wrong identity.
Regression tests prove mismatched store identity cannot execute or verify another Skill.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If a regression fails, inspect the identity boundary, make the smallest in-scope correction, and rerun required gates before merge.
